section_1.title: Extra support, if a condition makes study harder.
section_1.description: Covers study costs like assistive software, specialized equipment and non-medical support. Not a loan, doesn't depend on household income.

section_2.title: Who qualifies for DSA?
section_2.description: DSA is designed to support students with a wide range of learning needs, physical conditions, or mental health challenges.

cards.title: Learning difficulties
cards.description: Includes dyslexia, dyspraxia, ADHD, and other neurodivergent study needs.

cards.title: Mental health conditions
cards.description: Includes long-term anxiety, depression, PTSD, or other mental health challenges.

cards.title: Physical disabilities
cards.description: Includes chronic pain, visual or hearing impairments, mobility conditions, and long-term illnesses.

faqs.q: Do I get this money in cash?
faqs.a: Usually no. SFE pays for the services, software, or equipment directly to the suppliers, or reimburses you with proof of purchase.

faqs.q: Do I need a formal diagnosis?
faqs.a: Yes, you will need a diagnostic assessment or medical evidence from a qualified doctor or educational psychologist.
